summary: Agent must map business requirements to Stripe CLI operations: products, prices, customers, payment methods, setup intents, subscriptions, coupons, webhooks.
check_strategy: Verifier reads mock state via /__bench/state, computes per-resource atomic checks, and folds them by AND into 10 capability groups (setup gate + catalog/pricing/customers/payment-verification/subscriptions/churn-restraint/discount/trial-extension/webhook). Pure emit/grouping; atomic comparisons unchanged.

checks.description: All 3 product tiers created with correct names
Correct monthly/annual prices per tier; Enterprise has no annual
All 6 cohort customers created by email
5 payment methods + 5 setup intents linking converting customers (card verified before billing)
Each converter has a subscription on the correct plan/price
Frank not subscribed and marked churned in metadata
